global_constraints: GC01: Script CEO owns dispatch, scheduling, gates, authoritative state, commits, and publication; no coordinating LLM is introduced.
GC02: The Codex path never executes OpenCode or silently changes runtime, model, reasoning effort, or role.
GC03: Every role receives explicit model and reasoning settings; operator, reviewer, and director have separate identities and permissions.
GC04: Plans, specs, prompts, ledger summaries, and implementation comments are English; product UI copy retains its established locale.
GC05: Codex workers inherit no brainstorming transcript; all required task context comes from versioned artifacts and explicit packages.
GC06: Operator-owned RED/GREEN and independent semantic review remain mandatory; mechanical green alone never approves a task or branch.
GC07: Raw evidence determines gates; RTK only changes the model-visible rendering and never the command exit code.
GC08: Unknown, malformed, stale, interrupted, or mismatched results never advance authoritative state.
GC09: Resume is confined to a recorded task family and role; unrelated tasks and closing use fresh contexts.
GC10: Parallel workers use distinct worktrees; shared plan writes, integration, and publication are serialized by scripts.
GC11: Existing user changes, unrelated branches, Codex sessions, credentials, and installed plugin caches are preserved.
GC12: Jev remains optional advisory inference; it cannot dispatch, select a tier, approve, route, or write the authoritative ledger.
GC13: Each new run confirms local-only or push-and-PR publication and concurrency at launch; resume retains those choices and no automatic merge is allowed.
GC14: Compatibility is claimed only for runtime/platform/toolchain combinations backed by the acceptance matrix.

tasks.title: Make harness synchronization non-destructive
tasks.summary: Replace reset-based synchronization with inspected fast-forward-only updates and explicit divergence reports.
acceptance: Inspect git status, branch, remote and full commit ancestry; any failed inspection blocks mutation. Fetch reports errors without changing the working tree.

Equal revisions return unchanged. Clean strictly-behind checkouts automatically update using fast-forward-only after showing the diff summary and validating the candidate in isolation. --check-only permits inspection without application; no confirmation is needed for this safe update.

Ahead, diverged, dirty, unexpected detached HEAD or remote mismatch returns needs_user_merge; preserve commits, index, untracked files and working-tree bytes. Never reset, clean, stash, rebase or auto-merge divergence.

Provide --json structured report with state, before_sha, remote_sha, changed_paths, action and errors. Exit 0 for inspected/unchanged/updated, 1 needs_user_merge, 2 invalid invocation, 3 operational failure.
Use explicit vendor path/configuration; do not assume an OpenCode-only home. Accept Git worktrees whose .git is a file.

Cover ahead/behind/divergent, dirty/untracked, offline, failed inspection, detached and Windows-space paths. Validate the candidate before update; validation failure preserves current checkout/selection. Never report a rollback that did not occur.

tasks.title: Define shared runtime configuration and backend capability reports
tasks.summary: Add a backend-neutral manifest and model-selection handoff with read-only adapter capability probes.
acceptance: Validate version=1, backend codex or opencode, explicit roles, backend-specific settings, toolchains, retention, publication, positive timeout and max_parallel. Reject missing models and unsupported setting combinations; no product model defaults.

Model selection is obtained from the user before implementation by the interactive launch setup; this read-only round exposes needs_configuration and never launches an LLM to ask. Confirmed selections carry backend, roles, configuration hash and confirmation provenance.
pipeline-doctor --config FILE --project DIR --output REPORT returns 0 ready, 2 invalid input, 3 unavailable capability. It never installs, upgrades, dispatches, or edits user config.

Probe actual executable/help/version for each backend; Windows launcher discovery must distinguish native executables from PowerShell wrappers. Keep Codex and OpenCode setting/event/session semantics separate.
Record unknown live model/auth/policy support as unverified; help/version checks do not certify live behavior. Reports never expose credentials.
Produce immutable manifest bindings for backend/config/bundle/role hashes, executable/version, project identity, canonical plan and run identity. No fallback to a different model/backend.
Examples describe required selections without runnable hard-coded model choices. Test both backend fixtures, missing settings, unavailable binary, unsupported capabilities and Windows quoting.

Runtime schema records coder_cycle_limits=[5,3,3], retention_days=30, backend, confirmed model roles, explicit publication and max_parallel. Keep budgets configurable, require launch choices rather than silent concurrency/publication defaults, and preserve values on resume.

acceptance: Define normalized invocation identity, backend, role, task/family/episode, worktree, candidate/base, plan revision, config/prompt hashes, requested settings, evidence paths, provider session and process status.
Keep transport completion separate from semantic outcome. Reject malformed, truncated, stale or mismatched output; never recover APPROVED from regex fragments.

Future correction routing includes declared in-scope vs structural impact and affected paths/contracts; this round validates the fields but changes no router behavior.
Enforce required types/enums, discriminated role payloads and identity consistency. Both backend fixtures normalize to the same schema without treating backend session IDs as interchangeable.
No worker process is launched and no existing runtime consumer switches to unfinished contracts in this round.

tasks.title: Install immutable harness versions and bind projects with canonical documentation
tasks.summary: Package a complete harness and add safe project initialization while consolidating duplicated documentation.
acceptance: Install backend-specific entry points resolving a complete immutable bundle with runtime files, prompts, skills, canonical docs and license. Never patch an unrelated installed plugin cache directly.
Stage and validate a candidate bundle before atomically selecting it. Failed validation preserves the prior selection; pinned projects and active runs retain their old bundle.

harness-project init --project DIR --bundle ID --backend NAME writes versioned .superpowers/harness.json and idempotently merges a marked AGENTS.md section. Preserve existing instructions; do not scan or alter unrelated projects.
Project binding records bundle hash, backend config and policy references using relocatable identities. Diagnose missing pins without falling back to the newest installation.

README.md is the single canonical operational and architectural reference. Migrate useful current content, update orientation/prompts/skills/packaging/doc-check, then delete root CONTEXT.md and README-LLM.md. Reject active references to retired paths; preserve historical ADR/spec records.

Approved brainstorming proceeds directly to spec and plan without a second written-spec approval. Startup may automatically apply the validated safe update from task 1, while project pins and active runs remain unchanged.

Document existing OpenCode execution and future Codex execution honestly: Round 1 does not yet supply a working Codex pipeline. Package smoke checks validate files and contract fixtures, not live model behavior.

Cover install/update rollback, two pinned projects, user AGENTS content, idempotent enrollment, missing pin, both package paths and directory names with spaces. No remote repository creation or publication.

First pipeline use automatically enrolls only that project; initialization is idempotent and preserves existing AGENTS.md. Before subsequent new runs offer newer validated bundle changes and update the pin only on user acceptance.

Migrate every active consumer discovered by reference inventory in this same task, including agent startup, both pipeline skills, authoring/finishing skills and run-pipeline closing instructions. Update the explicitly listed documentation-contract tests without weakening runtime assertions; R1 must be usable before later rounds.
